claims.text: THAURA Home Story Constitution API Download Pricing FAQ Contact Try Thaura Keep the people's AI free. No investors, no ads, no strings. Your donation is what keeps Thaura answering to people, not profit, and free for everyone who needs it. Donate Why Support Thaura? We take no investors and no ad money, so no one can buy influence over Thaura. Your donation is what keeps it that way: honest, independent, and answerable only to you. Support the Mission Where your money goes. Every dollar goes straight into keeping Thaura running and independent, never toward ads or investors. Platform Development Building and running the AI itself, on our own servers, never on your data. Operations Keeping the lights on: servers, security, and essential operational costs. Outreach & Education Helping more people find private, ethical AI. Digital Rights Backing the wider fight for digital rights and privacy, beyond just Thaura. Free Access Covering free accounts for the people who need Thaura but can't pay for it. No Hidden Money Every dollar goes to running Thaura and keeping it free. No hidden fees, no investor profits. Every dollar keeps it in the people's hands. Your donation keeps Thaura independent and free for everyone who needs it. No investors. No ads. Just people. Make Your Impact Thaura AI that answers to you, never to advertisers or investors. Private by design.
